authorization: User approved adding public randomized experimental data; purchase versus same-budget random remains priority
unit: published row, anonymized user; unavailable advertiser/cookie identities prevent cluster validation

split.method: seeded pseudorandom independent uniform per original row, no label stratification

features.encoding: train-only top200 categories plus OTHER, native HGB categorical features; numeric float32 after category codes
features.missing: fail preparation if any source value missing

outcome: conversion, published 14-day binary purchasing outcome; no filtering on exposure/visit
propensity_source: v2 paper global rebalancing; benchmark assumption, actual original blocked randomization/sampling mechanism unavailable
nuisance: T-HGB31 fit TRAIN only, shared evaluation m0,m1 for all candidates; no training labels in validation/test
selection: highest validation AIPW covariance gain at fixed nominal10% among six candidates; tie by candidate name. Freeze selection before reading test outcomes. No refitting on validation
policy: Freeze score cutpoint and independent row-hash tie cutpoint from validation covariates/scores, exact round(q*n_valid) there. Apply same cutpoints to test. Test actual quota may differ from nominal; random benchmark matched to realized test proportion q_n, not silently called exactly10%
evaluation: mean((pi-q_n)*Gamma) where q_n=mean(pi); frozen threshold policy target covariance under released benchmark distribution
inference: iid influence-function normal approximation: IF_i=(pi_i-q_n)*(Gamma_i-mean(Gamma))-Delta_hat; sample variance(IF)/n. Includes uncertainty in realized policy fraction and ATE, not model training, sampling design, or actual original ad clusters
multiplicity: two-sided Bonferroni normal intervals alpha=.05/30 for all six candidates x five fractions against expected random; direct candidate pairs outside this family reported exploratory
success: validation-selected fixed10% model has test gain>0 and Bonferroni lower bound>0; report all 30 regardless. No success promise
robustness: unadjusted IPW and SNIPS point estimates; e=.84/.86 sensitivity on selected model; two prespecified hash halves of test descriptive consistency only; no model reselection from test
economic_scope: No original ROI/business rate recovery, online profitability or production effectiveness claim
